strongest_angle: Exploring the October 2026 director profiles of James McAvoy with his debut feature California Schemin' and Ben Affleck with his Netflix thriller Animals.

key_facts.fact: Director James McAvoy released his directorial debut California Schemin' in theaters across the U.S. in October 2026 after its premiere at the Toronto Film Festival.
Director Ben Affleck discussed casting, on-location rehearsals, and the Los Angeles setting of his thriller film Animals in a Netflix Tudum interview with John DiLillo.
James McAvoy stated that directing had been on his mind for 30 years before he finally made his feature directorial debut with California Schemin'.
James McAvoy utilized 2,000 strangers to help execute an ambitious scene while working with a limited budget on California Schemin'.
